subject.title: When calling a VLLM model, the usage page statistics show no data. How can I calculate usage and cost when using VLLM?

question: For vLLM/local providers, should OpenClaw surface missing cost with Usage-page or per-turn guidance when tokens are recorded but no positive model pricing is configured, or should that remain a docs/config-only responsibility?
rationale: Current code can record vLLM tokens and aggregate missing-cost entries, but deciding how strongly to warn or mark local zero-rate pricing affects intentional free/local models and belongs to maintainer product policy.

options.title: Keep evidence-first and route cost policy to the canonical pricing issue
options.body: Keep this issue open for reporter/live evidence and use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/90674 for the product decision about unknown-cost presentation.

options.title: Close as duplicate after token proof
options.body: If fresh evidence shows tokens are present and only cost is missing, close this issue as a duplicate of the canonical unknown-pricing issue.

options.title: Sponsor a vLLM-specific warning path
options.body: Adopt a vLLM/local-provider Usage-page or doctor warning for zero-rate pricing, accepting the need to avoid misclassifying intentional free local models.

recommendation.title: Keep evidence-first and route cost policy to the canonical pricing issue
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for reporter/live evidence and use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/90674 for the product decision about unknown-cost presentation.
